description: Ground truth for the context-dependent Go fixture (Vizzini ISSUE-022/023). Each defect is visible only with code outside the diff: the unchanged caller of retry.Delay, store.FindUser's nil result, cache.Handle's Release contract. report/admin.go is a decoy: store.Admin never returns nil, which only the context shows. A defect is caught when a finding in the same file overlaps any anchor line within +/- tolerance lines.

defects.note: client.Wait (unchanged) still multiplies by time.Millisecond, so retries wait 1-30 ms instead of seconds
Summary never calls h.Release, so each call leaks a file descriptor
FindUser returns nil for an unknown id; OwnerEmail then panics
